unstake: an unstake locks the funds while they unbond
spender: it approves a contract that is not verified
outside: the idea came from outside content
plugin: a community plugin is on, and its words reach every turn
deniedToken: it sells a token on your deny list
riskWarn: it buys a token that is not verified or has a risk warning
overFeeCap: the network fee is above your cap
locked: binference is locked; run `binference unlock` on the machine
